fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2025-10-13 states that a loan agent collected Rs. 3,50,000 from the complainant for approving a personal loan and then stopped answering calls, on 2025-10-12 at approximately 13:35. The online submission was made by Anand Chandran (9000000060). Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100012. The complainant alleged that Sathish Sundaram may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000372. The complaint refers to Udhay Muthu, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000352. The complainant mentioned transaction records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly claimed a guaranteed approval and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: loan fraud, processing fee, transaction record, residential colony, mobile number, associate, suspect, afternoon
